visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and glasses stands on a small, elevated dark stage wearing a plain white short-sleeved t-shirt and blue jeans. Behind him, a large white projection screen displays a still image of a silver car's front view. He holds a stack of white papers in his left hand and stands behind a microphone on a tall black stand. In the foreground, the silhouetted backs of two audience members are visible sitting in the darkened room. (2) The projection switches to a photo of a white ambulance. The man points with his right hand toward the red mirrored text on the hood of the vehicle, his expression shifting from serious to slightly amused as he engages the audience. The lighting is focused primarily on him and the screen, with the surrounding stage area remaining in deep shadow. (3) The slide changes to a high-contrast studio image of a red metal shopping cart. The man stands with his feet shoulder-width apart, holding his papers and gesturing emphatically with his right hand toward the screen while looking at the audience. He appears to be arguing a point, his mouth open in mid-speech. (4) The screen now displays a red car-shaped children's bed featuring a cartoon face on the front. The man leans in closer to the microphone, pointing specifically at the bed's design. He uses his hands to describe the physical shape of the object. The audience in the foreground remains static, looking toward the stage. (5) The projector shows a large white semi-truck and then a photograph of a person wearing a red cardboard car costume. The man on stage puts his right hand on his hip, looking at the audience with an expression of comedic exasperation. He holds the papers loosely at his side. (6) A large, bold Chinese character for 'car' appears on the white screen. The man points at it calmly. Suddenly, the character rapidly scales up, filling the screen. The man reacts by flailing his arms and falling backward, acting as if he were struck. He then moves to a Yamaha keyboard on the left, plays a few keys, and bows to finish the presentation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a neutral, narrative tone in Mandarin, his pitch is stable and speech rate is conversational. No background music is audible. Suddenly, multiple male voices from the crowd shout loudly in unison, exhibiting high arousal and intensity. This is followed by a short burst of moderate laughter. (2) The main speaker continues, his voice rising slightly in pitch as if responding to the interruption. His tone shifts to a more teasing and humorous style. Frequent interjections of male shouting from the crowd occur with high vocal projection, punctuated by cycles of audience laughter and ambient room tone. (3) The speaker's articulation remains clear even as he raises his volume to be heard over the crowd. There are audible incidental noises of paper rustling as he shifts the documents in his hand. The crowd noise intensity remains moderate, creating a lively live-performance acoustic environment without masking the speech. (4) As the speaker transitions toward the climax, his vocal intensity increases. He uses dramatic pauses for comedic effect. The audience reactions become more frequent, with overlapping speech patterns. There is still no melodic background music, only the dry acoustic of the indoor hall and the direct vocal signal. (5) In the final phase, the speaker emits a sudden, high-pitched scream with extremely high arousal. This triggers a loud synthesizer chord with a wide spectral bandwidth. Immediately, a dense crowd noise of applause and cheering erupts, dominating the mix as the speaker sings a single high-pitched note over the electronic texture.
